metadata.statistical_repeats: Three paired inference repeats, not independently trained models.
metadata.runtime_scope: Initial bank-acquisition measurements precede corrected downstream stages; these are not timings of the complete corrected pipeline.
metadata.private_provenance_omitted: Local execution paths and cluster hostnames are excluded; input manifest hashes bind the numerical tables.

comparison.policy: Corrected EFF-Dock primary pipeline; frozen native comparator rows retain their own budgets, selectors and evaluation provenance. No equal-compute comparison.

uncertainty.scope: Three paired repeats averaged within complex; descriptive percentile intervals, unadjusted.

complexity_failures.scope: Refined bank decomposition; generation failure means no refined RMSD hit.

baseline_uncertainty.scope: Frozen native-method outcomes vs corrected EFF-Dock; complex paired over three repeats, unadjusted percentile CIs. Native budgets/selectors differ; not an equal-compute effect.

selector_bottleneck.scope: Effective chirality eligibility uses unfiltered fallback; only selected poses have official PB labels. No full-bank PB oracle is inferred.

historical_bank_acquisition_runtime.runtime_definition: Sum of complete pipeline shard wall durations per complex; mean and sample SD over three seeds. Includes setup, generation, refinement, confidence and I/O; excludes separately executed official PB.
historical_bank_acquisition_runtime.memory_definition: Maximum initial generation/evaluation-process CUDA allocated peak across 16 shards and three seeds. Astex/PB use candidate_only generation; Phi/Fold/Open use confidence_cluster_free and include raw-confidence scoring in this process. Excludes separate refinement/post-refinement scoring processes. Not reserved memory or whole-pipeline peak.
historical_bank_acquisition_runtime.hardware_note: Recorded mixed GPU backends. Device case counts are retained; these descriptive costs are not a controlled cross-hardware speed comparison or saturated service throughput.
